contract_review.atomic_units: Contract rule 1 explicitly incorporates the original ten 0/1 units; five paired sums do not create additional units or mandatory content. Unit facts below are unchanged source preparation, not scores.

C1.1.fact: Stated collection name passes identifier validation; filesystem creation is outside this probe.

C1.2.fact: Scalar field 标题 fails the distinct ASCII field-name rule.

C2.1.fact: Document ID 客户 42/😀 passes the document identifier rule.

C2.2.fact: Limit is 1024 UTF-8 bytes; 汉 is three bytes, so 341=1023 passes and 342=1026 fails.

C3.1.fact: U+0009 TAB is forbidden; document ID validation returns INVALID_ARGUMENT.

C3.2.fact: TAB fails the prevalidation loop before any write loop iteration; none of the three documents is inserted.

C4.1.fact: TAB produces an overall unexpected result; Insert unwrap maps INVALID_ARGUMENT to Python ValueError, without returning per-item statuses.

C4.2.fact: Duplicate batch produces a successful result containing statuses [OK, ALREADY_EXISTS, OK]; the per-item error is not passed through the overall error mapper.

C5.1.fact: The duplicate status is appended and the loop continues; first and last fresh documents are inserted under the explicit no-other-errors assumptions.

C5.2.fact: Existing seed-id payload stays old: INSERT detects the existing ID and returns before WAL/internal insertion, rather than overwriting.

interpretation_notes.assessment: Not a blocker. All document validation precedes writes is an ordering property. TAB stops the validation loop at the middle document; the third document need not be reached. Do not require a claim that all three validations completed.

Only an unexpected outer Result reaches throw_if_error. A successful vector can contain a non-OK Status; ALREADY_EXISTS is not individually unwrapped. Python Status binding exposes values rather than throwing for each item.

Under ordinary valid Python strings and schema-compatible fields/vectors, conversion sets the native primary-key string. TAB rejection occurs in the native ID validator. R13/R14 support this; no requirement that an answer enumerate all wrappers.

The zero-write conclusion follows prevalidation for this TAB batch, not general transaction atomicity. Fresh writes and unchanged old payload follow the explicitly excluded concurrency/segment-switch/I/O/other failures. No claim of crash durability or filesystem creation is required.
The duplicate check protects the existing stored payload before WAL/internal_insert. This does not claim that no temporary Doc field was ever assigned or sanitized.

conclusion: No material ambiguity or source-based blocker. Exact contract faithfully preserves original q005 scoring and citation semantics.
